author: nils
text: board.py post gains --to <name>[,<name>...] (stored as a lower-case 'to' list; 'all' = everyone; shown as '(to a,b)' in every listing). The PostToolUse hook delivers to a DEVELOPER reader (a name whose seat file in meta/team/ is dev-<n>) only: entries addressed to it or to all; key 'steer' and 'contract:*'; replies on a key the reader has posted on; entries whose --supersedes points at one of the reader's own entries (an answer to its question). Everyone else keeps the full feed: coordinators (po, sm, team-lead) and any reader the hook cannot map to a developer seat (unnamed sub-agents), so the filter fails open, never hiding a blocker. Filtered entries advance the cursor and never reappear as new; the hook header says the feed is filtered and that 'board.py log' has everything. Grants (owner:*) and answers are posted --to the developer they concern. read, current, log and wait are unchanged. Implementer: Nils; documented by Vera from the latest entry on this key.

author: tomas
text: check.py as built (refines #11): 'check.py run --as <you>' (no paths) classifies the branch diff against --base (default: merge base with main; committed + uncommitted + untracked): frontend/ -> frontend; backend/, wcl_agent/, .githooks/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .claude/team/*.py -> backend; anything else -> config. backend -> pytest; frontend -> npm ci if node_modules missing, vitest run, npm run build (a build-rewritten clean tsbuildinfo is restored); both -> all three. Config-only with no paths is REFUSED (exit 3): name the targeted tests; that targeted run then writes a receipt with area=config. Targeted paths may mix pytest files and frontend/**/*.test.tsx (vitest). A targeted run on a code branch writes no receipt. Receipt records area, base, commands. 'run --full' = pytest + vitest + build (area=full). 'verify [--ref R|--index]' prints 'REUSE: tree X passed area=<a> (ran: ...)'; 'verify --need-full' accepts only a full receipt. Old receipts read as area=backend. RESULT line: 'RESULT PASS: `check.py run ...` area=<a> -> pytest: ...; vitest: ...; npm: build ok'. mutate.py: --test frontend .test.tsx files run under vitest (whole files; no mixing with pytest tests), same baseline/restore/not-a-bite rules.

author: tomas
text: check.py amended (071, supersedes #34 where it differs): 'verify' now recomputes the area the branch touches (diff of the verified tree against the merge base of the target and the ref; target = verify --base REF, default merge base with main) and prints 'receipt base <sha>, branch touches <area>'. It exits 1 'RUN NEEDED' when the receipt's area does not cover the touched area (full covers all; backend+frontend need both; config/none are covered by anything). A '--base' on run or verify must resolve to a commit (git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options) and may not start with '-': else 'REFUSED' (run exit 3, verify exit 1). Receipts now store the base as a SHA. Maren: agent files that call 'check.py verify' keep working; mention verify --base for a non-main merge target.
